responsibility: This target header specializes the SPARC GNU/Linux 64-bit configuration, including bi-arch support when SPARC_BI_ARCH is enabled. It defines Linux/SPARC64 preprocessor macros, 32/64-bit link specs and multilib defaults, cc1 option rewriting for -m32/-m64, default CPU/tuning spec propagation, AddressSanitizer restrictions, assembler specs, type and long-double properties, TLS/SSP offsets, and related ELF userland conventions needed for Linux SPARC64 and mixed 32/64 compilation.
